US-119-HJRES219.title: Proposing an amendment to the Constitution of the United States to require a Judge to be a natural born citizen of the United States.

actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on the Judiciary.

US-119-HJRES219.aiSummary: The resolution would propose a constitutional amendment saying federal judges must be natural born U.S. citizens. It would also remove any current judge who is not a natural born citizen two years after the amendment is ratified. The change would affect judges in the Supreme Court and lower federal courts.
